Trump's approval ratings have raised concerns among some Republicans as the party heads into the 2026 midterms. Nationally, 35 percent of voters approve of Trump's job performance while 59 percent disapprove as of August 27, leaving him significantly underwater with a net approval rating of -24, according to Civiqs' rolling online tracking poll of registered voters.

The survey has garnered 126,377 responses since January 20, 2025, when Trump was inaugurated for a second term. When asked in April 2025, Trump's first three months were rated at 61% approval by Oklahoman polltakers. Now in August 2026, Trump remains at 52% approval in Oklahoma.

Nationally, Trump has an unfavorable majority across all ages, education levels, genders, and races. Trump's only favorability among Civiqs' demographics is found in the 82% of Republicans who remain faithful to the president.
